node.title: Re: Looking for alternative syntax for assigning variables based on regex matches
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
my ($x,$y) = $foo =~ /(hello)(world)/ or die "failed to match"; if ( my ($x,$y) = $foo =~ /(hello)(world)/ ) { print $x, $y; } if ( $foo =~ /(?hello)(?world)/ ) { print $+{x}, $+{y}; }

Update: The first two work like any other variable assignment, so ($foo) = $foo=~/(hello)/; works too of course. (Update 2: If assigning back to the same one variable, so does s/// and its variations.)
